verdict: Strong 28-day ROAS, but the last three days show a revenue slowdown.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5.60 for every $1.00 spent, driving 44 purchases and $8,302.75 in revenue on $1,483 in ad spend — a healthy window overall. The concern is recent: the last three days (Sep 23–25) produced only $460 in revenue versus $2,430 in the three days prior, with average order value dropping sharply from $379 to $166. Spend levels have held steady, so this is a revenue-mix issue, not a spend spike. We're watching the campaign closely and refreshing the approach to bring order values back in line. Four planned milestones from August remain open and are being worked through now ahead of the September 30 deadline.
